About

About Abu Dhabi Properties

Abu Dhabi Properties is an independent, English-language guide to established real estate developers active in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

What this guide is

We profile developers that are shaping Abu Dhabi's residential landscape — their background, where they work, the kind of communities they build, and where to find their official information. Each profile links directly to the developer's own website so that readers can continue their research at the source.

What it is not

We are not a real estate broker or agency, we are not registered with the Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre (ADREC) or any other regulator as a broker, and we are not an authorized representative of any developer. We do not sell property, collect buyer enquiries, publish prices or recommend investments.

How companies are selected

The current selection — Aldar Properties, Modon, Bloom Holding and Reportage Group — is editorial. It is not a ranking and does not suggest that these are the largest or best developers in Abu Dhabi. See our editorial policy for how profiles are researched and kept up to date.

Independence

The companies featured have not paid to appear and have no control over what we write. Their names, logos and links are used only to identify them. If sponsored placements are introduced in future, they will always be clearly labelled as such and kept separate from editorial profiles.
